scoring_justification: Recompute linear extrapolation from finite-size data and compare to agent's extrapolated values; then compare extrapolated values to paper gold.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold values for extrapolated transition points and latent heats from paper.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's reported numeric results.

outputs.description: Finite-size data for verification of the transfer-matrix pipeline and self-consistency check.
Extrapolated transition points and latent heats to be compared with hidden reference values from the paper.

output_contract.notes: Scoring checks self-consistency between the finite-size data and extrapolated results, then compares the extrapolated Kc and Q to the paper's reported numbers within tolerances. The finite-size CSV must have exactly 12 rows.

steps.description: Validate CSV structure and check that extrapolation from finite-size data matches extrapolated_results.json values.
Compare extrapolated Kc and Q values to paper's gold tolerances.
